examples.english: Understanding remote-first is useful for senior backend engineers.
examples.persian: درک مفهوم «remote-first» برای مهندسان ارشد backend مفید است.

examples.english: We need to consider remote-first before making the final decision.
examples.persian: قبل از تصمیم نهایی باید «remote-first» را در نظر بگیریم.

miniContext: In a professional backend environment, remote-first is part of the language engineers use when discussing real systems, requirements, implementation, and production concerns. Senior engineers are expected to explain the concept clearly, connect it to practical engineering decisions, and discuss its consequences with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Understanding this vocabulary makes technical meetings, documentation, and job interviews easier to follow and easier to communicate.
